title: Finch Circle Points Ledger Schedule — Return Frequency Cushion
content:
**Schedule.** When Finch Circle Loyalty Program points are taken back on a refunded return, the return frequency cushion is 0.95 when the membership shows no other return deduction entry dated within the last 12 whole months, 0.98 when it shows exactly one, and 1 when it shows two or more.

The other return deduction entries are counted on the membership's own points history, by their entry date, within the last 12 whole months.

| Other return deduction entries dated within the last 12 whole months | Return frequency cushion |
|---|---|
| none | 0.95 |
| exactly one | 0.98 |
| two or more | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A member's first return deduction in over a year: 0.95.
- One other return deduction entry eight months ago: 0.98.
- Return deduction entries two and five months ago: 1.
